en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a long brick barracks complex with ornate gables and many evenly spaced windows. The buildings form one side of an open parade ground or field, with small trees planted in front. In the foreground stand a woman in a light dress and wide-brimmed hat and a man in dark clothing. The printed caption at the top reads in German, identifying the location and the barracks of a carabinier regiment.
